market_view: VIX 18.7 is moderate, not stress. Oil fell sharply on easing US-Iran tension (WTI -7.5%, Brent -8.7% on 07-27), a chip rout spread from Seoul, and the 10-year sits near its 1-year high at 4.64%, a headwind for gold and long-duration stocks.

oil_gas.catalyst: none; the long's catalyst reversed: 'Oil Slides, European Gas Falls as US-Iran Tensions Ease' (dars.gov.et) and 'crude oil prices fall for the first time in a week' (AP News)
oil_gas.reasoning: Handoff exit rule triggered: the Iran supply shock is de-escalating and Brent fell 8.7% in a day. XOM long closed to flat. Q2 earnings in the window add variance only; no new one-sided catalyst.

gold_miners.reasoning: Gold -10.6% over 60 days, 10-year yield near its 1-year high, dollar firm. NEM Q2 already reported. No headline gives a one-sided setup; the 5-day bounce is not a catalyst.

chips.reasoning: Headlines are negative ('SK Hynix Shares Tumble 10%', 'chip stocks get clobbered', CNBC); NVDA -5% on the day. No NVDA-specific catalyst; big tech earnings add variance. Do not guess a rebound.

pharma.reasoning: Generic drug tariffs from 2028 do not hit LLY's branded franchise directly; LLY Q2 results in early August raise variance only. Retatrutide wins are priced after a 40% 60-day run.

copper_uranium.catalyst: none for FCX ('Cameco gets UBS upgrade', Yahoo Finance, concerns CCJ, not the leader)
copper_uranium.reasoning: Copper steady near highs with no supply shock headline; tariff and EU-US deal effects unclear for copper. The uranium upgrade is indirect for FCX.

would_change_my_mind: Renewed tanker attacks or Hormuz/Red Sea closure (oil); an LLY guidance raise at Q2; an export-control easing or strong NVDA-related capex guidance.

handoff.what_changed: US-Iran tensions eased: WTI fell 7.5% to 82.6 and Brent 8.7% to 88.4 on 07-27, so the XOM exit rule fired and oil_gas is now flat. A chip rout spread from Seoul (SK Hynix -10%, NVDA -5%). New global tariffs drew criticism; generic drug tariffs planned from 2028; UBS upgraded Cameco.

oil_gas.why: Iran supply shock de-escalating per 'US-Iran Tensions Ease' headline and an 8.7% Brent drop; catalyst gone.

gold_miners.why: Gold downtrend with yields near the 1-year high; NEM Q2 done; no catalyst.

chips.why: Sector rout with negative headlines and no NVDA-specific catalyst.

pharma.why: No LLY catalyst before Q2 results; 2028 generic tariffs not directly relevant.

copper_uranium.why: No FCX catalyst; Cameco upgrade is indirect for the leader.
